title: Firefox profiles (XDG location)
whyItMatters: New Firefox installs keep their profiles under ~/.config instead of ~/.mozilla. The folder holds the same history, bookmarks, cookies and saved logins, so a scan that only looks at ~/.mozilla misses them.
source: Mozilla Bugzilla 259356, support for the XDG Base Directory spec: new Firefox profiles use $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/mozilla/firefox: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=259356
notes: Unconfirmed: the release number (147, January 2026) comes from Mozilla release notes and press coverage, not from a page this agent read; the Bugzilla bug is the primary source for the path. Only fresh installs and new profiles move; an existing ~/.mozilla/firefox keeps the legacy location, so both rules are needed. The * matches the profile folder and prefs.js is the marker.
